newsitem.title: USA: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - @Entertainment sees little gain.
newsitem.headline: IPO HIGHLIGHTS - @Entertainment sees little gain.

text.p: @Entertainment Inc, the only company to make its Wall Street debut on Thursday, failed to generate enough investor enthusiasm to trade far above its opening price.

The Poland-based company, which is that country's largest multi-channeled pay television business, priced at $21.00 a share, within its range of $18.50 to $22.00. Underwriters Goldman Sachs sold 9.5 million shares of the company's stock to complete a $199.5 million initial public offering.
@Entertainment opened at 21-1/8, hitting a high of 21-3/4 before slipping slightly to trade at its opening levels at midday.
